blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese arrived in the Philippines on Saturday ahead of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in Metro Manila. Footage released by Asean Philippines 2026 showed Albanese being welcomed upon his arrival in the country on Nov. 14. Albanese is among the leaders of Asean’s dialogue partners attending the regional gathering hosted by the Philippines from Nov. 15 to 17.
